Taiwan elections: KMT loses 25-year hold on Hsinchu tech hub in magistrate vote. Kuomintang candidate Hsu Hsin-ying lost the Hsinchu county magistrate election on Saturday, failing to retain the main opposition party’s administrative helm against Cheng Chao-fang, the challenger from Taiwan’s ruling Democratic Progressive Party.
The KMT had maintained continuous leadership in Hsinchu county since 2001, losing the stronghold of the northern hi-tech hub area, just 30 minutes by high-speed rail from Taipei.
